changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 9, item 6: flipped .dependency-cruiser.cjs's no-circular rule, every generated layer-order-* rule, and every namedEdgeRules entry from warn to error, now that items 1-5 closed all 36 baseline violations (verified with a clean 0-warning, 0-error depcruise run; no exception rules were needed). Rewrote the file's header comment, which used to explain why the gate stayed warn-only, to describe the now-enforced error gate instead. Reworded the two namedEdgeRules comments that used to cite tests/collection-ownership.test.ts and tests/workflow-service.test.ts as evidence to state each invariant directly, since those test files are retired separately by this stage's test-deletion item. Dev-tooling config only; no runtime or published-API change.
